sql.propToolPanel.getAllForCompany: select p.id, p.panel_name, p.wattage, p.panel_color, p.panel_type, p.active, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(panelStates))) FROM ( SELECT pt.id, pt.panel_id as "panelId", s.state, pt.company_state_id as "companyStateId", pt.adder_amount as "adderAmount", pt.archived FROM props.panel_state pt inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = pt.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id WHERE pt.panel_id = p.id and pt.archived is not true) panelStates), '[]') AS "panelStates" from props.panel p where p.company_id = :companyId and p.archived is not true order by p.panel_name
sql.propToolPanel.getOne: select *, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(panelStates))) FROM ( SELECT pt.id, pt.panel_id as "panelId", s.state, pt.company_state_id as "companyStateId", pt.adder_amount as "adderAmount", pt.archived FROM props.panel_state pt inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = pt.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id WHERE pt.panel_id = p.id and pt.archived is not true) panelStates), '[]') AS "panelStates" from props.panel p where id = :id
sql.propToolPanel.insert: insert into props.panel(panel_name, wattage, panel_type, panel_color, company_id, active, created_by_id) values (:panelName, :wattage, :panelType, :panelColor, :companyId, :active, :createdById)
sql.propToolPanel.update: update props.panel set panel_name = :panelName, wattage = :wattage, panel_type = :panelType, panel_color = :panelColor, active = :active, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :id
sql.propToolPanel.delete: update props.panel set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.propToolPanel.insertStates: insert into props.panel_state(panel_id, company_state_id, adder_amount, created_by_id) values (:panelId, :companyStateId, :adderAmount, :createdById)
sql.propToolPanel.updateState: update props.panel_state set adder_amount = :adderAmount, date_modified = now(), archived = :archived where id = :panelStateId
